[opaque block] [contact omitted] Iñigo Fernández, [opaque block] [contact omitted] Murillo Laranjeira, [opaque block] [contact omitted] María Julia Diaz
Ardaya, [opaque block] [contact omitted] Héctor Faya, [opaque block] [contact omitted] Arantxa Guillén, [opaque block] [contact omitted] Brian Townsend,

Brockwehl
Hello Mickie,
I hope you are doing well, it's a pleasure to e-meet you.
I'm the policy lead for Central America and the Caribbean in Íñigo's team, who is Meta's POCs for Mexico, Central America and
the Caribbean countries.
We appreciate your interest and would love to have you join us in our event in Guatemala. This will take place on November 9
starting at 10:00 am in the Forum Zona Viva (3 Avenida 10-80, Guatemala City 01010, Guatemala). We hope to have over 150
MSMEs and members of the creative economy.
This will be the kick off event for the initiatives we will deploy all over Central America as part of our commitments to the
Partnership for Central America.
During the event we will showcase the initiatives within this commitment, provide a test-training on some of its verticals, and also
attest to our impact in the country through stories and experiences from local businesses. We will also announce the launch of
our augmented reality training program, which will be Meta's first big step towards the collaborative construction of the
Metaverse in the country.
Please see the preliminary agenda below.
Hora Actividad
10:00 10:30 Registration.
10:30 - 11:15 Tour through our Interactive Gallery. Networking with local creators.
11:15 - 11:20 Beginning of the opening ceremony.
11:20 11:27 Words from Meta representative.
11:27 - 11:40 Words from the Minister of Economy, Janio Rosales.
11:40- 11:45 Official photograph.
11:45 12:00 Break.
12:00 - 12:05 Video showcase of success stories.
12:05 - 13:00 Training on digital skills. Part 1 - Spark AR.
13:00 13:10 Break.
13:10 - 14:00 Training on digital skills. Part 2 - Facebook & Instagram.
14:00 14:10 Break.
14:10 15:00 Training on digital skills. Part 3 WhatsApp.
15:00 - 15:05 Closing.

I will be reaching out to the points of contact you shared within the Guatemalan Mission as we would love to have them
participate in the event. We also extended an invitation to Ambassador Popp through the official channel: [opaque block]
[opaque block] you can also find it attached to this email.
Please let me know if you have any questions or if you'd like us to jump on a quick call.
Best,
Deborah Galindo (she/her/hers)
Manager | Public Policy for México, Central America and the Caribbean
Facebook Mexico S. de R.L. de C.V.
Meta | [opaque block]

Subject: Re: Escobari/Meta Follow-Up
Hi Catherine and Nicolas,
Thanks for clarifying where your team is based. Could you also clarify if y'all have any other contacts based in the
countries in the region? Or only in Mexico, Colombia, Argentina and Brazil?
I'm including current Points of Contact for our USAID Missions who focus on related issues. 1 am also copying Sandy
Luff, who has also been in communication with Alex Brockwehl in our office regarding the upcoming event in Guatemala
on Nov. 9. And we're including more contacts in our USAID Mission in Guatemala, if they would also be invited to
participate in the event?
We appreciate the invitation, and would like to join on the 9th, if you could send us further details.
Nicolas - we look forward to continuing the discussion on a joint project, are there some times available for you to connect
next week?

On Wed, Oct 19, 2022 at 9:55 PM < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Mickie,
Thanks for your message. The specific POCs are:
• Iñigo Fernández for Mexico, Central America and the Caribbean (his team is based in Ciudad de
Mexico).
• María Julia Diaz Ardaya for the Spanish-speaking countries of South America (her team is based in
Bogotá & Buenos Aires).
• Murilo Laranjeira for Brazil (his team is based in Brasilia and Sao Paulo).
Let me know if you need any further information.
Sincerely,
Nicolás

Subject: Re: Escobari/Meta Follow-Up
Hi Catherine,
I hope you're enjoying all things pumpkin spiced this season. :)
Thanks for your message and following up. We are confirming a few final POCs to finalize the list - we have more than
17 different POCs across the region.
Can you specific POCs for each country to connect with? Most USAID POCs are based in each country in our USAID
Missions within each Embassy. Could you clarify, who is the counterpart that they could meet with personally in each
country?
Thanks,
Mickie Mitre

Best,
Catherine

[opaque block] [contact omitted]>, Pedro Less < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>, Shaarik Zafar < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>,
inigo Fernández < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>, Murillo Laranjeira< [opaque block] [contact omitted]>, Maria
Julia Diaz Ardaya < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Escobari/Meta Follow-Up
Dear Kira,
I'm glad to hear that you and Luis will continue to be the POCs. I will be out of the office next
week but would be happy to schedule a meeting after that to discuss possible specific joint
actions.
Regarding Meta's POCs:
• Iñigo Fernandez covers Mexico, Central America and the Caribbean countries.

Murillo Laranjeira covers Brazil.
• Maria Julia Diaz Ardaya covers the Soth American Spanish speaking countries.
Let us know who the USAID Mission POCs are once the list is updated.
Thanks a lot!
Sincerely,
Nicolás
From: Kira Mitre <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Wednesday, September 28, 2022 5:07 PM
To: Catherine Eng < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: Luis Azurduy <[contact omitted]»; Brian Rice [opaque block] [contact omitted]>; Sandra Luff [opaque block] [contact omitted]>; Pedro
Less < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>; Nicolas Comini < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>; Shaarik Zafar < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Escobari/Meta Follow-Up
Dear Catherine, and Nico,
Many thanks again to both of you, Brian and Pedro for hosting us yesterday! So great to meet you. We greatly
appreciated the discussion and value continued collaboration in the region. And thanks for following up so quickly!
And great to meet you Shaarik, at least virtually for now.
Luis and I will continue to be POCs for the Latin America and Caribbean Bureau for follow up. One of the next steps
we identified is connecting our respective colleagues within each country, including our USAID Mission Points of
Contact (within each Embassy) with a Meta POC counterpart in each country. Would you be able to share country
level POCs to connect with our USAID Mission contacts? And we'll share our USAID Mission POCs (we're currently
updating on our side as the Foreign Service transfer season occurs in the summer).
Looking forward to continuing collaboration!
very best regards,
Mickie Mitre
-

Latin American and Caribbean Bureau (LAC)

On Wed, Sep 28, 2022 at 3:48 PM Catherine Eng [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Dear Mickie and Luis,
Many thanks to you and Assistant Administrator Escobari for taking the time to meet with us
this week. We appreciated the opportunity to exchange our ideas on how we can collectively
address challenges and support opportunities in the region. As discussed, we wanted to
follow-up on a few action items as we define upcoming workstreams.
1.I am copying Nico Comini, our Public Policy Manager for LATAM, to this email. He will
serve as the main POC in facilitating coordination between your team and the
appropriate folks on our regional team.
1. I'll be the main POC for our US Policy team.
1.I am also copying Shaarik Zafar, Public Policy Manager for External Affairs. He has
been our main contact with the Partnership for Central America. The group would
benefit from his participation as well.
2. Please let us know with whom our teams can be in touch on your side.
Looking forward to continuing our engagement. Many thanks.
Best,
Catherine
